headline: Committee closes testimony and passes criteria amendment on a five-to-four vote

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: After the chair closed oral testimony, the committee passed an amendment to the property criteria with five ayes and four noes. Another member proposed a criterion on 2008 unit occupancy, and staff will double-check which properties meet the criteria.
meeting.recap: A testifier said Bill 9 was meant to increase housing for people who live and work here.[[0:22:42]] Another testifier said she could not support what she called an attempt to undermine Bill 9.[[1:38:16]] A testifier said she believed 26 properties are proposed for permanent hotel zoning.[[3:07:42]] A condo owner testified in support of the resolutions.[[3:32:20]] The chair closed oral testimony.[[3:34:29]] The chair proposed covering structures fully inundated in the sea level rise exposure area or flood hazard zones.[[4:01:09]] The motion required structures fully inundated by the 3.2-foot sea level rise area or flood hazard area, and not originally meant for affordable workforce housing.[[5:07:43]] A member moved to cover structures that are majority impacted, including areas under Maui Planning Commission shoreline rules.[[5:19:27]] That amendment passed with five ayes and four noes.[[5:22:15]] Another member proposed a criterion about how many units residents occupied in 2008.[[5:23:36]]
decided: The chair closed oral testimony without objection.
meeting.next: Committee staff will double-check which properties meet the criteria.

moments.q: "Hotel zoning is not a shoreline management strategy."
